title: ывыв /selfdev requires a local Desktop self-development chec

compaction.summary_text:
**Context:** I'm migrating the user's (xenking) agent harness from a previous agent harness to jcode CLI and Jcode Desktop. Both run from his own forks (`~/projects/github.com/xenking/{jcode,jcode-desktop}`) plus the self-hosted `jcode-cloud` backend on the NAS ai-core. I act as swarm coordinator: I spawn workers, verify their results myself, and report in Russian.

**What we did:**

*Earlier work (still valid):*
- **Skills and hooks:** 43 skills plus 29 mattpocock skills; hooks `peon-ping`, `no-ai-slop` and `git-guardrails`.
- **srh MCP:** connected with OAuth, lists 37 tools.
- **jcode fork features:**
  - Soniox v6 voice.
  - Codemode TS improvements.
  - `MCP-Protocol-Version` header fix.
  - `ask` tool.
  - Updater points to xenking.
- **Secrets:** stored in `~/Library/Application Support/jcode/*.env`.
- **Backups:** `~/.jcode/migration/`.

*This stretch:*
- **Context files:** audited with the claude-md-improver rubric.
  - New `jcode-cloud/AGENTS.md`.
  - Fork notes appended to the jcode and jcode-desktop `AGENTS.md`.
  - `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` now has a plain-ssh rule; em dashes removed.
- **jcode-cloud:** pushed to a new **private** GitHub repo `xenking/jcode-cloud` (main).
- **jcode master commits** (all pushed):
  - **Compaction:** per-model `[compaction.models]` overrides, shown in `/info` (8e4e7ba4b).
  - **Shake** (dd75fbab3), plus a warm-cache guard (08ebe3452; I verified 7/7 tests in a clean tree).
  - **Theme:** Monokai Pro Ristretto TUI palette (b38d98cb1).
  - **Compact events:** reported on completion and failure (f08864113).
  - **Manual `/compact` tail bounded to 40k** (e87070df0, 4ccd5bfb1). Live result: 167k → 32k tokens, the codeword was recalled.
  - **Snapcompact port** (c6df35f03..870f4cad0, 3f9f77c0a "native before snapcompact"). Claude read 5/5 hidden facts from the PNG pages alone.
  - **Provider quotas:** `/usage` command and a TUI status line showing both providers (6c752618e).
- **Routing and limits:**
  - Subagents default to `openai:gpt-6.1-terra`; the DeepSeek line stays commented out.
  - terra/sol: window 1.05M, compaction at 400k (OAuth, so no price cliff).
- **Installed CLI:** shared daemon runs `versions/3f9f77c0a`, on gateway `100.65.207.94:7643`.
  - Its real socket is `/var/folders/1c/7fb7bbdn43s5jxfxkwnpyc080000gn/T/jcode.sock`.
  - Install method: copy the build into `versions/<sha>`, `jcode server promote`, symlink `~/.jcode/builds/current/jcode`, `jcode server reload`.
  - On macOS replace the binary via a new file plus `mv` (the signature cache SIGKILLs an in-place overwrite).
  - Touch `crates/jcode-build-meta/build.rs` so the version string refreshes.
- **jcode-desktop main commits** (all pushed):
  - d762e72: compact events.
  - 2617fe9: quota footer.
  - 118db05: theme test fix.
  - 6b68659 / 77d2646: reopen sessions after a clean quit; revive a dead harness bridge; robust runtime dir when TMPDIR points elsewhere.
  - 8f99da4: compact footer chips; honest account status ("Connected", "In use").
  - 29fbadc: swarm workers in the sidebar plus a "Waiting for N workers" strip.
- **Installed Desktop:** clean build 29fbadc, installed via `~/.jcode/migration/install-fork-desktop.sh`, which now pkills stale bridges.
  - Verified: 4 panels restored, the bridge auto-revived, a test session replied "ok", and the footer fits on one line.
- **Desktop outage (caused by me):**
  - A stale bridge from the old bundle stayed running.
  - I then killed the bridge.
  - I also launched Desktop from the agent shell, which has `TMPDIR=~/.jcode/scratch`.
  - Fixed: the bridge is restored, and tulip's code changes prevent a repeat.
  - Lesson: never kill the bridge, and never launch Desktop with the agent TMPDIR.
- **legacy chain parity** (remote → snapcompact → handoff → shake → soft, dropUseless, idle): 4 workers failed to ship it. The WIP is in `git stash` "legacy-parity WIP" in the jcode repo; paused.
- **Config:**
  - Theme `monokai-pro-ristretto`.
  - `snapcompact = true`, `shake = true`, `shake_cache_expiry = false`.
  - Opus override: threshold 550k, `max_context_tokens` 600k. It apparently doesn't apply, since the pill shows /1.0M.
  - `[provider]` now has `openai_auto_banked_reset`, `anthropic_auto_fable_reset` and `auto_reset_only_when_no_routes` all = true (backed up first).

**Current state (5 Opus workers running; await id ...60824555eb044edc):**
- **fish (desktop-compact):**
  - Remove the v0.7.0 label and make the UI more compact.
  - Provider popover: Search and Close on one row, drop the "Select provider" title.
  - Stop scroll from popovers leaking into the transcript.
- **fox (claude-resets):** Claude shows "Reset availability unavailable"; get the 2 banked resets the way the old harness does and verify with a real count.
- **hamster (swarm-view-fix):**
  - The live sidebar and waiting strip don't show workers. Likely root cause: the bridge reads `$RUNTIME/durable-state/swarm` while the daemon writes `~/.jcode/state/swarm`.
  - Also fix the coordinator session title being renamed to each new lane label.
- **pig (cache-compaction):**
  - Fix the Opus override key match (prefix or alias).
  - Set opus to 500k threshold with a 1M window, and show the threshold in the pills.
  - Enable shake and add a snapcompact trigger on cache expiry (legacy idle semantics), with runtime proof.
- **rooster (auto-redeem):** add `auto_reset_trigger` ("exhausted" | "blocked_wait_over") and `auto_reset_min_wait_minutes = 10`; dry-run verification; reuse fox's parser.

**Next:**
- Verify each report myself.
- Build and promote the CLI; package and install Desktop with a clean tree, launching it normally rather than from the agent env.
- Live-check everything with screenshots.

**Open items:**
- Desktop Sparkle appcast returns 404, so auto-update doesn't work.
- Session send/raise into arbitrary sessions doesn't exist; I offered it as a separate task.
- OpenCode Go and Parallel keys are still pending from the user.

**User preferences:**
- Russian, terse replies; they get angry at breakage and at missing waits. Wait for workers and verify via the real runtime and UI before claiming done.
- Use swarms. Use Opus workers for hard tasks, since terra workers stalled.
- Own `xenking/*` repos: commit and push freely, no stray branches or worktrees. Never touch upstream.
- Plain ssh. Never print secrets. Soniox v6. Jev uses the OpenAI Decisions API.
- Wants legacy-equivalent compaction behavior (snapcompact, shake, cache-based compaction, 500k for Anthropic).
- Wants a compact UI, sessions restored after restart, a visible orchestrator waiting state, and auto-redeem of resets.
